result.stdout:
Description:
  Calibrates a decision model against a labelled dataset, checks that a provider conforms, exports recorded decisions as a labelled dataset, and compares a candidate with the primary on shadowed decisions.

Usage:
  minos [command] [options]

Options:
  -?, -h, --help  Show help and usage information
  --version       Show version information

Commands:
  calibrate      Runs a labelled dataset against a provider, then writes the results and a calibration report.
  report         Builds the calibration report again from saved results and their dataset, without calling a provider.
  export         Turns recorded decisions with confirmed outcomes into a labelled dataset and a signals file.
  shadow-report  Compares the primary and the candidate of shadowed decisions: agreement, confusion tables and calibration against confirmed outcomes.
  conformance    Sends the conformance probes to a live provider and checks its answers. Exits 1 when a check fails; a skipped check passes. The bad-key check is skipped when no API key is configured.

result.stdout:
Description:
  Runs a labelled dataset against a provider, then writes the results and a calibration report.

Usage:
  minos calibrate [options]

Options:
  --dataset <file> (REQUIRED)  The labelled dataset: a JSONL file with one item per line.
  --config <file>              The config file, JSON with a Minos section. Environment variables such as Minos__Providers__<name>__Model override it. [default: minos.json]
  --provider <name>            The provider section of the config to use. Default: the section named by Minos:Active.
  --model <id>                 The model to call, in place of the section's Model. Default: the section's Model, then the provider's default model.
  --parallel <n>               How many items run at once. [default: 1]
  --prices <file>              A prices file, JSON, that prices the tokens of a provider that reports no cost. Default: none, so only reported costs count.
  --out <dir>                  The directory for results.jsonl, report.json and report.md, created when missing. Default: minos-out/<provider>-<UTC yyyyMMdd-HHmmss>, with the provider section being run.
  -?, -h, --help               Show help and usage information

  --dataset <file> (REQUIRED)  The dataset the results were run on: a JSONL file.

  -?, -h, --help               Show help and usage information

  Turns recorded decisions with confirmed outcomes into a labelled dataset and a signals file.

Usage:

Options:
  --records <file> (REQUIRED)  The record file a recorder wrote: a JSONL file of decisions, outcomes and erasures.
  --out <dir>                  The directory for dataset.jsonl and dataset.signals.jsonl, created when missing. Default: minos-out/<provider>-<UTC yyyyMMdd-HHmmss>, with the provider export.
  -?, -h, --help               Show help and usage information
